summary: Planted change c42-plant (SPEC3 F9; never merged: orch/automerge.sh refuses rbd-plant PRs): catalog Rank: +8 ms CPU spin (mechanism spin; placement: top of Rank, before its first statement: every call (before any cache lookup or early return)). Intended effect: +8 ms of CPU per call of Rank on an idle core (more wall time on a contended CPU or under the pod's CPU quota). The registered dose is the A/B-measured own-time delta of catalog, not this knob.
